frontMatter.title: Badminton Weekly Round-Up: Big Wins, Cup Finalists & One More League Push
frontMatter.summary: This week’s results as our teams picked up key league wins, a vital draw, and multiple cup victories to reach the final. Next week is the final league round before playoffs—every match matters.

prev.title: Meath Badminton: Leinster CAC Intercounty Finals – 22nd March
prev.summary: This Sunday (22nd March), Meath competes in the Leinster CAC Intercounty Finals in Baldoyle and Tolka Rovers, with club members representing the county across every grade. Semi-finals start at 10am, finals at 2pm—best of luck to all teams. An Mhí Abú!

next.title: Monday Club Night at Claremont
next.summary: Monday Club Night in Claremont: Grade 2 & Grade 4 Ladies matches, two member social courts from 9pm, plus Juvenile Club (Girls 6:30pm, Boys 7:30pm).
